question: What attributes of the eternal person are honored in this salutation?
premises: Salutation is offered to a person.
That person is described as thousand-named and eternal.
That person is described as bearing a thousand crores of ages.
inference: The salutation honors an eternal, thousand-named person who sustains vast cosmic ages.
uncertainties: The exact numerical sense of sahasrakoṭi may be hyperbolic; UNC.
plain_english: Salutation to the eternal Person, who has a thousand names and bears a thousand crores of ages.
